name: page2ai-mcp
description: Convert any web page to clean Markdown for LLM context
long_description:
Page2AI MCP converts a web page URL to Markdown for AI context windows. It keeps the page's main content (its <main> or dominant <article>), preserves code blocks with language hints, converts tables and lists, and drops navigation, headers, footers and sidebars. The only network requests go to the URL you pass it and the addresses it redirects to, asked for as a browser opens a page, so docs platforms return the page itself rather than a Markdown copy of it: pure Node + linkedom, no browser, no cookies, no page scripts, no external services, no telemetry. A page behind a sign-in, or one rendered only by JavaScript, is therefore out of its reach.

Companion to the Page2AI browser extension (https://github.com/igorsaevets/page2ai-extension), which converts the live page in your own browser, including pages behind a sign-in. Built on the open-source @page2ai/core library.
